title: An open recipe trains a coding model to paint with JavaScript
friendlyTitle: A coding model learned to paint watercolours with an open recipe
summary: Hugging Face published an open reproduction of Surya Narreddi’s viral experiment in which a language model writes JavaScript that renders watercolor-style paintings. The recipe exposes the dataset, reinforcement-learning environment, training scripts, models and a reward system combining execution checks with learned aesthetic preferences.
friendlySummary: The model writes JavaScript that draws a painting. Hugging Face published the training tools and models so others can study and repeat the experiment.
whyItMatters: Code-generated art remains readable, editable and repeatable in ways that a single image-model output is not. The experiment also makes an important limitation visible: when reinforcement learning optimizes taste, the curated references and model judges quietly define what the system learns to value.
friendlyWhyItMatters: People can read and edit the code behind each picture. The project also shows that the chosen examples and AI judges strongly shape what the model calls beautiful.
